item.description:
Background usage refresh

Turn on Background usage refresh in Settings to refresh the active local profile every 5, 15, 30, or 60 minutes. It starts off, with 15 minutes selected, and each profile remembers its own preferences.

  • Refreshes quietly while SubFuse is running, including when another app has focus. Pauses for sleep and stops when you quit.
  • Shows attempt counts and the last fully successful refresh. Failed updates preserve saved readings and retry less often.
  • Prevents overlapping manual and automatic operations, and rejects late results after cancellation or profile changes.
  • Preserves existing profiles, remembered Claude and Cursor sign-ins, costs, and renewals.

Supports Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. This beta is not Apple-notarized.
